text:
Priya (CS): Heads up — AsterBiotech renewal flagged. Observed ~60% drop in monthly token usage since last week's onboarding. They've started a PoC with a competitor (VeloxAI). Renewal in ~8 weeks. Can we triage?
Ethan (AM): Saw the numbers. MAU down 60%, embeddings calls down ~75%, chat activity steady but limited to one pilot team. I’m pulling logs. Initial error spike shows some 429s and SAML timeouts.
Samir (Solutions): @Lizzie can you confirm contract/credits history? Also they reported our KB docs didn’t match their flow — we should run a follow-up enablement.
Lizzie (RevOps): Procurement contact is Claire@asterbio. We provided a one-time 10% credit last renewal. Legal is requesting some contract clarifications today; don’t pre-empt with more discount yet.
Priya (CS): Champion Dr. Huang moved teams and is now evaluating Velox. Advocate exit + onboarding quality is a risk. Need to capture feedback and set up remediation session this week.
Ethan (AM): Quick diagnostic query I ran: `SELECT date, tokens_used, call_type FROM usage WHERE account = 'asterbiotech' ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 30;` shows a sharp tokens_used drop starting 2024-12-07. Also saw repeated `ERROR 429: rate limit exceeded` from their integration logs.
Samir (Solutions): I can run a 45m deep-dive workshop: agenda — SSO flows, rate-limit tuning, batching/KV cache setup, model recommendations (Redwood-2-small vs open mini). Need a customer contact + 2 possible slots.
Priya (CS): Claire prefers Thu 10am PT. Please reserve. Also we need a short playbook and a one-pager addressing embeddings scale and common pitfalls.
Lizzie (RevOps): I’ll prepare renewal timeline and procurement notes. Link to our renewal playbook (internal): https://redwood.internal/cs/playbooks/renewal-playbook — will summarize options but hold discounts until after the workshop.
oncall-bot: Notice: incident 4372 — SSO flakiness detected in SAML provider region us-west-2; may impact affected customers.
Ethan (AM): Confirmed 3 SAML timeouts on 2024-12-18 14:21 UTC tied to the customer's auth provider. I’ve opened an eng-infra ticket and linked this thread.
Samir (Solutions): Tagging @DevEx to prep a sandbox and step-by-step runbook for the workshop (include sample payloads and small benchmark script).
Priya (CS): Next steps: 1) Book workshop Thu 10am PT (Samir) 2) Eng infra triage SAML/timeouts (Ethan) 3) Procurement touchpoint + hold discount (Lizzie) 4) Capture customer feedback and follow-up in 72h. Ethan — please share the usage export here ASAP.
Ethan (AM): Uploading export now to shared drive: https://drive.redwood/exports/asterbiotech-usage-dec2024.csv. :thumbsup:
Claire (AsterBiotech): Thanks — we kicked off a Velox pilot because embeddings stopped scaling for us. Appreciate the deep-dive. If you can show concrete changes to reduce cost/latency, we’ll consider staying.
Priya (CS): Understood. I’ll lead the workshop. Samir — draft agenda & checklist and post here. Lizzie — I’ll wait on any pricing moves until after the session.
Samir (Solutions): Draft agenda posted in shared doc; highlights: 1) reproduce their ingest -> embedding flow 2) tune batching & kv-cache 3) SSO sanity checks 4) quick quant/latency tradeoffs demo.
Priya (CS): Thanks team. I’ll follow up with a recap thread after the workshop and a recommended remediation plan.
Lizzie (RevOps): I’ll also prepare a renewal timeline with decision checkpoints at 2w and 4w before renewal.
Priya (CS): Closing loop for now — keeping as renewal-risk-high until we run the enablement and SSO fix.
